public_rationale: Gato's report acknowledges limited dialogue capabilities, while PaLM's report documents substantial benchmark success. Neither establishes broad competence of the kind Marcus describes. But incomplete competence alone does not establish that no system was remotely close. The stronger proximity claim remains unsettled by the located evidence.
limitations: The evidence covers selected systems and tasks.
Benchmark performance is an imperfect measure of general comprehension and intent modeling.
The claim supplies no defensible boundary for remotely close.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: No current AI is remotely close to comprehending arbitrary text to model speaker intent or reasoning about arbitrary problems coherently.

statement.excerpt: But no current AI is remotely close to being able to read an arbitrary text with enough comprehension to be able to build a model of what a speaker is saying and intends to accomplish, nor able (a la Star Trek Computer) to be able to reason about an arbitrary problem and produce a cohesive responsive.
statement.document_title: The New Science of Alt Intelligence

from_speaker: what a speaker is saying and intends to accomplish
our_interpretation: Current refers to systems existing when the post was published, not systems developed later.
Arbitrary means diverse ordinary unseen texts and problems, rather than every logically possible input or an impossible requirement of perfection.
The apparent typo cohesive responsive is read as coherent, relevant response.
The ordinary capability target is broadly reliable comprehension, including communicative intent, and coherent reasoning across unfamiliar problems.
Not remotely close is stronger than not fully solved. No numerical distance or readiness threshold is supplied.
The target is May 2022 up to publication. Earlier evaluations are contextual evidence for this latest partial-month snapshot.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evaluations of leading contemporary systems show substantial, persistent gaps across text comprehension, speaker-intent inference and general reasoning, sufficient to establish distance from broad reliable competence.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A contemporary system demonstrates broadly reliable performance sufficiently near the described competence across diverse unseen texts and problems, including communicative intent.

evidence.explanation: The authors' description supports a substantial limitation for Gato. One model's limitations cannot establish the distance of every contemporary AI system from the capabilities Marcus describes.

evidence.locator: Language Understanding and Generation, BIG-bench comparison
evidence.explanation: The comparison concerns a selected set of BIG-bench tasks and demonstrates substantial progress relevant to assessing proximity. It does not establish reliable comprehension of arbitrary texts, speaker intent or general problem solving.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Broad evaluations of the leading systems available by May 14, 2022, covering unseen texts, communicative intent and general reasoning, with an explicit and defensible standard for proximity.
